acceptanceCriteria.text: IWorkspacePathNormalizer.Combine treats a segment with one leading backslash as root-relative on Windows: it keeps the current root's volume, the drive (C:/) or the UNC server and share (//srv/share/), and replaces the rest of the path, on a Linux hub and a Windows host (PR 81 finding P12, PR 82 review).
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/QBrainAi.Support.Mcp.Tests/Storage/WorkspacePathNormalizerContractTests.cs (CombineResolvesRootRelativeWindowsSegmentAgainstDrive, CombineResolvesRootRelativeWindowsSegmentAgainstUncShare); WorkspacePathNormalizerMockDataTests.cs (RootRelativeNegativeControls_AreRejectedInsidePassingHarness); PR 82 commits f6768359 and dcd0269a

result.description: Introduce a single request-path normalization entry point (IWorkspacePathNormalizer backed by WorkspaceIdentityPath) with an injectable host-platform abstraction; all resolvers listed in section 1.2 use it. No direct Path.GetFullPath on request-supplied workspace paths outside it (enforced by an architecture test).
